caption: In a kitchen with an orange wall and a range hood above a stove holding a frying pan, one hand grips the black handle of a round glass dispenser filled with dark red liquid. A second hand holds a clear glass jar at the right edge of the frame. Over the clip the jar drifts leftward and upward, closing the gap to the dispenser's bulb. The hand tilts the dispenser, and the red mass inside shifts, pooling against the lower side of the bulb. The jar is angled so its opening sits near the upper side of the bulb, held close but with no liquid seen passing between the vessels. Both hands hold this aligned posture through the later frames. The stove and pan remain static in the background. The excerpt ends with the vessels still positioned together, no transfer yet visible.
